summary: HomeTrust Bancshares, Inc., the Maryland-incorporated holding company for HomeTrust Bank (NYSE: HTB), filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 on October 6, 2026, solely to announce that it intends to issue its third quarter 2026 earnings release before the market opens on October 21, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanic is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary scheduling notice signed by CFO Tony J. VunCannon, carrying no special-situation implications; there is no deal to arbitrage, no regulatory clock, and no overhang.
